# Envoy Medical Submits Second Module of Modular Premarket Approval Application to FDA for Breakthrough Designated Acclaim(R) Cochlear Implant


October 12, 2026 8:30am EDT


*Second of Four Planned Modules Moves Rolling FDA Review Forward*


*Advances Toward Targeted Completion of the Final Clinical Module Submission in Q2 2027*


White Bear Lake, Minnesota--(Newsfile Corp. - October 12, 2026) -[Envoy Medical](https://api.newsfilecorp.com/redirect/87YyXi57rx) ® Inc. (NASDAQ: COCH) ("Envoy Medical" or the "Company"), a hearing health and neuroprosthetics company pioneering fully implanted hearing solutions, today announced the submission of the second module of its Modular Premarket Approval ("PMA") application to the U.S. Food and Drug Administration ("FDA") for the Acclaim® cochlear implant, which has received FDA Breakthrough Device Designation.


The second module, which included primarily engineering information, follows the Company's submission of the first module on June 30, 2026. Envoy Medical expects to submit a total of four modules on a rolling basis, with the final module containing final clinical trial data and completing the PMA application.


"The submission of our second module is an important milestone that demonstrates measurable progress," said Brent Lucas, Chief Executive Officer of Envoy Medical. "With two of the four modules submitted, we continue to steadily march along our defined regulatory pathway."


What the second module submission means for Envoy Medical:


-


**Progress on a rolling timeline:** Half of the planned modules are now with the FDA, allowing the agency to review submitted sections while clinical data collection continues.


-


**Continued FDA dialogue:** Each submitted module provides another opportunity for the Company to receive feedback and address questions before the final submission.


-


**Remaining milestones:** The Company expects to submit two additional modules, including the final module containing clinical trial data, towards the end of the second quarter in 2027.


The fully implanted Acclaim® cochlear implant received Breakthrough Device Designation from the FDA in 2019 and is currently under investigation as part of a U.S.-based pivotal clinical trial. For more information on the trial, visit[www.envoymedical.com/acclaim-pivotal](https://api.newsfilecorp.com/redirect/y40JVHan2G) .

**About Envoy Medical, Inc.**


Envoy Medical (NASDAQ: COCH) is a hearing health and neuroprosthetics company focused on providing innovative technologies across the hearing loss spectrum. Envoy Medical has pioneered one-of-a-kind, fully implanted devices for hearing loss, including its fully implanted Esteem® active middle ear implant, commercially available in the U.S. since 2010, and the fully implanted Acclaim® cochlear implant, an investigational device. Envoy Medical is dedicated to pushing hearing technology beyond the status quo to improve access, usability, compliance, and ultimately quality of life.


**About the Fully Implanted Acclaim® Cochlear Implant**


We believe the fully implanted Acclaim Cochlear Implant ("Acclaim CI") is a first-of-its-kind hearing device. Envoy Medical's fully implanted technology includes a sensor designed to leverage the natural anatomy of the ear instead of a microphone to capture sound.


The Acclaim CI is designed to address severe to profound sensorineural hearing loss that is not adequately addressed by hearing aids. The Acclaim CI is expected to be indicated for adults who have been deemed adequate candidates by a qualified physician.


The Acclaim Cochlear Implant received the Breakthrough Device Designation from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) in 2019.


CAUTION The fully implanted Acclaim Cochlear Implant is an investigational device. Limited by Federal (or United States) law to investigational use.


**About the Esteem® Fully Implanted Active Middle Ear Implant (FI-AMEI)**


The Esteem fully implanted active middle ear implant (FI-AMEI) is the only FDA-approved, fully implanted hearing device for adults diagnosed with moderate to severe sensorineural hearing loss allowing for 24/7 hearing capability using the ear's natural anatomy. The Esteem FI-AMEI hearing implant is invisible and requires no externally worn components and nothing is placed in the ear canal for it to function. Unlike hearing aids, you never put it on or take it off. You can't lose it. You don't clean it. The Esteem FI-AMEI hearing implant offers true 24/7 hearing.


Important safety information for the Esteem FI-AMEI can be found at:[https://www.envoymedical.com/safety-information](https://api.newsfilecorp.com/redirect/1KLyRiw52b) .
